Direct fetches: HRW Asia/Bhutan landing page (all prison items concern the 28 political prisoners held in 'dreadful conditions', nothing on trans placement), Penal Reform International /global/bhutan/ (404), and the UNAIDS laws-and-policies 'transgender people' joint-analysis page for Bhutan (JavaScript shell, no retrievable content). No source was located documenting where trans prisoners are housed in Bhutan — no birth-sex vs identity placement policy, special unit, solitary/segregation practice, or trans-prisoner case/ruling. Bhutan's small penal system and absence of legal gender recognition make formal classification binary by birth sex by default, but no fetched source documents actual housing practice, so no add was made.
